entities.name: John Sainsbury, Baron Sainsbury of Preston Candover
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: John Davan Sainsbury, Baron Sainsbury of Preston Candover was a British businessman and politician. He served as the President of Sainsbury's, and sat in the House of Lords as a life peer and member of the Conservative Party.
